info.title: Multi-Vendor E-Commerce Backend API
info.description: Enterprise-grade multi-vendor e-commerce backend built with Express.js, Prisma 7, PostgreSQL (Supabase), and Cloudinary. Supports vendor onboarding with admin approval, product catalog with search/filter/pagination, atomic multi-vendor checkout with automatic stock deduction and order item splitting, and vendor-isolated order management.
